five_tables.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='SuperMarket';

birthyear_removed.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='SuperMarket' AND TABLE_NAME='Student' AND COLUMN_NAME='BirthYear';

qgperiod_int_nullable.sql: SELECT CONCAT(DATA_TYPE,':',IS_NULLABLE) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='SuperMarket' AND TABLE_NAME='Goods' AND COLUMN_NAME='QGperiod';

inprice_decimal.sql: SELECT CONCAT(COLUMN_TYPE,':',IS_NULLABLE) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='SuperMarket' AND TABLE_NAME='Goods' AND COLUMN_NAME='InPrice';

student_unique_removed.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='SuperMarket' AND TABLE_NAME='Student' AND INDEX_NAME='uq_student_weixin';

supplier_index_removed.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='SuperMarket' AND TABLE_NAME='Supplier' AND INDEX_NAME='uq_supplier_no';

category_index_directions.sql: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(COLUMN_NAME,':',COLLATION,':',NON_UNIQUE) ORDER BY SEQ_IN_INDEX) FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='SuperMarket' AND TABLE_NAME='Category' AND INDEX_NAME='uq_category_no_name';

only_new_range_check.sql: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONSTRAINT_NAME) FROM information_schema.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA='SuperMarket';
